title: How many shortest routes tie?
hook: A tied distance may still bring new routes worth counting.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Track distance and count separately, adding counts only for equal-distance relaxations.

misconception: A shortest-path algorithm keeps only one route and cannot count ties.
objective: Track distance and count separately, adding counts only for equal-distance relaxations.

claims.text: Distance improvements replace counts; tied distances add counts.
